content.title: Planar Folktale Chapters | Material Birth to Emblematic Ascent
content.summary: Keep one handcrafted planar stage and material grammar across discovery, same-material birth, a folded community chapter, symbolic offerings, one object-caused material rupture and a visible ascent. The final wide must retain the celestial goal, grounded witnesses and earlier spatial anchors.

quick_start.input_format: coherent planar handmade stage, discoverer, sealed luminous container, clearly adult central figure and celestial goal first + central figure unfolds from the container's same material + existing layers fold into a community chapter with at least two witness groups delivering symbolic objects + accumulated objects cause exactly one controlled full-frame material rupture that exposes the night layer + same adult ascends along a visible material path + terminal wide contains destination, ground witnesses and at least two earlier spatial anchors
quick_start.recommended_input: On an ochre-and-indigo paper desert stage, an adult archivist opens a luminous seed vault and an adult wind cartographer unfolds; market witnesses offer compass tiles, the tiles burst into a star map, and white paper currents lift the cartographer toward a fixed north-star seal above the retained market and vault.
required_anchors: Establish one coherent planar material grammar, a discoverer, sealed luminous container, central adult figure and celestial destination system.
Open the sealed object and unfold the central figure from that same material without replacing identity.
Use accumulated objects in one controlled material rupture that exposes the night layer and celestial goal.
Show the same adult figure ascend along a visible material path and finish wide with the destination, ground witnesses and at least two prior setting anchors.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Keep one handcrafted planar stage and material grammar across discovery, same-material birth, a folded community chapter, symbolic offerings, one object-caused material rupture and a visible ascent. The final wide must retain the celestial goal, grounded witnesses and earlier spatial anchors.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Build one original planar handmade-story stage with a persistent material grammar, one grounded discoverer, one sealed luminous container, one central adult figure and one celestial destination. Let the discoverer approach and open the container so the central figure unfolds from the same material. Reconfigure the existing layers into a community chapter where at least two witnesses bring symbolic objects that establish social recognition. Accumulate those objects, then use one controlled full-frame material rupture to expose the night layer and previously recoverable celestial goal. Carry the same adult figure upward along a visible material path while ground witnesses remain legible, and end in an emblematic wide that contains the destination plus at least two earlier spatial anchors. The reusable mechanism is planar discovery, material birth, chapter-fold transition, social recognition, material rupture, vertical departure and total-story tableau—not the source Kaguya-hime identity, Japanese folktale, bamboo, garments, gifts, house, moon composition, silhouettes, exact paper craft, color sequence, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one coherent planar material grammar, a discoverer, sealed luminous container, central adult figure and celestial destination system.
invariants.purpose: Gives every later transformation shared spatial and material rules.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a common stage and goal system, the chapters become unrelated illustrations.

invariants.rule: Open the sealed object and unfold the central figure from that same material without replacing identity.
invariants.purpose: Makes the protagonist's arrival physically causal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting directly to a person removes the discovery-to-birth handoff.

invariants.rule: Reconfigure existing layers into a community chapter where at least two witnesses deliver symbolic objects.
invariants.purpose: Moves the story from private discovery to visible social recognition.
invariants.ablation_failure: A solitary pose cannot establish the community phase.

invariants.rule: Use accumulated objects in one controlled material rupture that exposes the night layer and celestial goal.
invariants.purpose: Turns social abundance into the physical cause of departure.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated sky cut breaks the chapter transition.

invariants.rule: Show the same adult figure ascend along a visible material path and finish wide with the destination, ground witnesses and at least two prior setting anchors.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity and closes the entire story geography.
invariants.ablation_failure: An isolated moon portrait cannot prove departure from the established world.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source Kaguya-hime identity, Japanese folktale roles, faces, hair and exact costumes
the source bamboo forest, glowing bamboo stalk, village house, gifts, nest bundle and attendants
the source cream-green-blue paper palette, full moon, white ribbons and silhouette styling
the source exact discovery, birth, offering, paper-burst, moon ascent and final tableau compositions
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording and 30-second timing
